error_class: TemplateMaterializationError(ValueError); .code:str; str(exc)==code only; catches accepted F106 errors and raises same code without input/body/token/SQL content

stages.rule: type(loaded_registry) is dict and type(bound_language) is dict; otherwise INVALID_INPUT. No other field inspected.

bound exact keys schema_version,status,locale,language_pack_version,registry_version,approved_template,approved_fact_ids; schema_version FIRST_ACTION_LANGUAGE_V1; status BOUND; locale/versions exact builtin str. Otherwise INVALID_SCHEMA. template/facts content deferred to stage5.
template_id, bound.language_pack_version, bound.registry_version exact builtin str fullmatch [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}. Check in that order. Otherwise INVALID_IDENTIFIER.

Invoke actual F106 build_policy_language_fields(loaded_registry,locale=bound.locale); preserve F106 .code through own exception. Revalidate ALL packs; locale validation/active check belongs actual F106. No duplicate business validation before this call. После успешного actual F106 вызова запретить builtin subclasses в loaded tree: container dict/list и scalar str обязаны иметь exact type. Несоответствие approved_fact_ids => INVALID_FACT_SET; active/default locale => INVALID_LOCALE; versions/template IDs => INVALID_IDENTIFIER; template kind/subject/body/fact_ids => INVALID_TEMPLATE; template locale => TEMPLATE_LOCALE_MISMATCH; остальные container/schema нарушения => INVALID_SCHEMA. Обход в порядке accepted F106: facts, schema, identifiers, locales, active-order packs, template insertion-order. Все реальные F106 ошибки всегда раньше этой strict-success проверки.

Create ephemeral pack {schema_version:FIRST_LANGUAGE_PACK_V1,locale:bound.locale,version:bound.language_pack_version,templates:{template_id:bound.approved_template}}; call actual F106 validate_language_pack(pack,approved_fact_ids=bound.approved_fact_ids) FIRST. Any actual F106 error immediately re-raised as TemplateMaterializationError with exact unchanged .code. Only after successful F106 call perform additional strict-builtin checks sequentially: approved_fact_ids type is list and every item type is str -> INVALID_FACT_SET; approved_template type is dict and exact five fields -> INVALID_SCHEMA; kind type is str -> INVALID_TEMPLATE; template locale type is str -> TEMPLATE_LOCALE_MISMATCH; subject type is str -> INVALID_TEMPLATE; body type is str -> INVALID_TEMPLATE; fact_ids type is list and each item type is str -> INVALID_TEMPLATE. Thus builtin subclasses accepted by legacy F106 are rejected here without replacing or reordering actual F106 errors. No F106 private function import or duplicate validator.
selected pack=loaded.packs_by_locale[bound.locale]. bound.language_pack_version must equal BOTH loaded.language_pack_versions[locale] and selected.version; else PACK_VERSION_CHANGED.
template_id present in selected.templates else TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND.
selected.templates[template_id] == bound.approved_template deep exact equality (including list order and literal whitespace), else TEMPLATE_CONTENT_MISMATCH.

bound approved_fact_ids subset loaded approved_fact_ids else FACT_SCOPE_MISMATCH. Template fact subset of bound already checked at stage5, failure code UNAPPROVED_FACT. This removes ambiguity; no remapping of F106 codes.
Return exactly nine fields from result contract; deepcopy mutable fact_ids; all inputs unchanged; no shared mutable output references.

result_exact.subject: byte-for-byte Unicode literal approved_template.subject
result_exact.template_id: exact validated template_id; exact registry pack/templates relationship proven

rules: No formatting, variables, interpolation, eval, markup interpretation or translation. Body commands and braces remain literal text. No product-specific core. Preserve Unicode, names, links, line breaks, whitespace, fact-list ordering and duplicates policy enforced F106.

Do not manufacture QA success flags, external_effect_authorized, release mode or owner approval. Literal static materialization does not establish personalization, grammar quality, or contact/materials QA. No template or locale selection here: F120 remains sole bound-template selection owner.

Fixture packs en-GB and ru-RU include INITIAL,QUESTION,OBJECTION,FOLLOWUP,HANDOFF. Exact accepted F106 schema and paired semantics; explicit synthetic no real product promises, no invented facts. Initial subject nonempty; other subjects may be empty. Use no placeholders that require interpretation. Include de-DE synthetic single-template fixture to show generic core, no live language support claim.

Load each full EN/RU fixture pack through real F106 API, obtain selected exact template and construct frozen F120 fixture output. Five kinds x two locales positive materialization cases. Runtime pack publication/real product-specific approved wording remains separate pilot setup/integration work.
acceptance: real F106 loads EN/RU five-kind fixture packs
accepted F106 regressions separately + own golden output
template_id points to different equal-kind but different body => TEMPLATE_CONTENT_MISMATCH
bound template differs in fact-list order or whitespace => TEMPLATE_CONTENT_MISMATCH
all loaded packs revalidated even selected locale valid
integration: F120 bound template + trusted actually loaded F106 registry + retained selected template_id -> F122 validates identical pinned source and materializes literal text -> integrator maps subject/body into exact F114 payload. No repeat F105 binding decision or now checks. HANDOFF text never replaces F119/F109 full context. Current preparation QA/fact/source gates remain required. No sales_preparation_contract edit; ru-RU whitelist mismatch remains R07 integrator obligation.
exclusions: No literal commercial claims without future approved product facts
No pack publication or claim bilingual sales quality verified
